verdict.rationale: Quo is a cloud business phone and communications platform, and self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted, on-premises or open-source deployment of the core product. The pack describes only a hosted service (web and mobile apps, a cloud API, a public MCP server) and a hosted API or MCP server does not count as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
